persons.aliasHint: Required for transfer and account detection.
persons.lastPersonError: The last person cannot be removed.
persons.aliasMandatoryPlaceholder: How does the name appear in bank transactions? (Required)
persons.minOwnerError: At least one person-owner is required.
persons.birthYearError: Year of birth must be between 1900 and {{year}}.

settingsDescriptions.dev_mode: Shows experimental features and debug information.

data.title: Data & Backup
data.dbPathHint: The active database file. Do not delete this file to avoid data loss.
data.backupDirHint: Klarwert stores automatic backups here (e.g. before updates) and saves CSV exports.
data.exportCsvSuccess: CSV export saved in Klarwert folder (Documents)
data.hint: In addition to automatic backups, data can be saved in open formats at any time.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deletes all stored data (accounts, transactions, categories, rules).
danger.confirmDescription: Enter 'delete' to confirm resetting the app.

about.title: About Klarwert
about.description: 100% local, private SQLite database, no login, no cloud.

communityData.title: Community Data
communityData.description: Merchant categories and bank profiles, curated by the Klarwert community.

quotes.title: Price Data (Securities)
quotes.description: Optional fetching of closing prices for your portfolio positions. Disabled by default.

community.desc: Loads merchant categories and bank profiles from the community repo. No account data leaves your device.
community.bankProfilesHint: Bank profiles are automatically offered during the next import if the column fingerprint of your CSV file matches.

templates.noTemplatesFound: The file contains no bank templates.
templates.description: Bank templates determine how Klarwert reads a CSV file from your bank (which column is date, amount, recipient, etc.). Built-in templates are protected – edit them to automatically create your own copy.
templates.importPreviewDesc: {{count}} templates found. Which ones should be saved?
templates.deleteDesc: "{{name}}" will no longer be used for automatic recognition during import.

editorModal.descBuiltin: This template is bundled with Klarwert and can't be edited directly. Your changes will be saved as your own copy.
editorModal.descCustom: Enter how the columns in your bank's CSV file are named, and assign a meaning to each column.
editorModal.columnsHint: Open your export file once and copy the column headers exactly as they appear there.
editorModal.importAllColumns: Also import unmapped columns as extra info (viewable via the eye icon)
editorModal.errorNameRequired: Please enter a name for the template.
editorModal.errorColumnRequired: Please enter at least one named column.
editorModal.errorRolesRequired: At least 'Date' and 'Amount' must be assigned to a column.

customFieldsManager.empty: No custom fields yet. Fields are created during import from columns you mark as "Import as extra field".
customFieldsManager.hint: New fields are created automatically when you mark columns as "Import as extra field" during file import.
customFieldsManager.deleteConfirm: Really delete this field? All associated data will be lost.

quoteSettings.privacyNote: Quote requests are cached in the local database. Fetching happens at most once per day per security. This is the only optional network access this app makes – all other data stays exclusively on your device.
quoteSettings.title: Automatic quote data
quoteSettings.apiKeyStorageNote: API key and secret are stored in the macOS Keychain – not in the app database.

yahoo.label: Yahoo Finance
yahoo.description: Free, no registration required. Uses the public Yahoo Finance data service (the same endpoints as the open-source yfinance Python package).
yahoo.privacyNote: Only security identifiers (ISIN/ticker) are sent to Yahoo Finance - no quantities, no portfolio values, no account details.

alpaca.label: Alpaca Markets
alpaca.description: Real-time and historical price data. Requires a free Alpaca account and API key/secret (BYOA - Bring Your Own Account).
alpaca.privacyNote: Only ticker symbols are sent to Alpaca Markets - no quantities, no account data. Alpaca stores API usage data per its own privacy policy.

manual.label: Manual entry
manual.description: No network access. Prices are maintained entirely manually.
manual.privacyNote: No network access. No data leaves the device.

updateChecker.autoCheckHint: Asks GitHub once on startup whether a newer version is available.
updateChecker.checkUnavailable: Update check currently unavailable (e.g. no internet connection).
